steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A tally chart uses strokes to record data count, with every fifth stroke crossing the previous four for easy counting. | Key Fact: A frequency table lists each data value or class alongside its frequency (count of occurrences). | Key Fact: Grouped frequency tables organise continuous data into class intervals; each interval has a lower and upper boundary. | Key Fact: Class width is the difference between the upper and lower class boundaries; all classes in a table may have equal or unequal widths.
